notes: Campaign structure follows docs/GAME_BRIEF.md. Mission success thresholds and rewards remain unbalanced placeholders.

Submission rewards reuse original badge identities with explicit 15-mission topic-completion criteria; legacy six-level performance thresholds are not applied. No star ratings or economic rewards are inferred.

levels.name: First Light
levels.learning_objective: Understand how sunlight can make electrical power.
levels.mission_objective: Establish the first safe energy supply for the base.
levels.debrief: Review when panels made power and what limited their output.

levels.name: Power Storage
levels.learning_objective: Explain why stored energy helps through the night.
levels.mission_objective: Add battery storage and keep essential systems powered.
levels.debrief: Compare stored energy before and after the night.

levels.name: Energy Manager
levels.learning_objective: Recognize that powered systems compete for limited energy.
levels.mission_objective: Choose which loads stay on while protecting essential systems.
levels.debrief: Review the trade-offs behind the power plan.

levels.name: Dust on Mars
levels.learning_objective: Describe how dust on panels can reduce sunlight collection.
levels.mission_objective: Inspect panel output and choose a cleaning plan.
levels.debrief: Compare clean and dusty panel output.

levels.name: The Great Storm
levels.learning_objective: Use a forecast to prepare for a dust storm.
levels.mission_objective: Protect essential power during a storm by planning loads and cleaning.
levels.debrief: Review which preparations helped during the storm.

levels.name: Greenhouse Online
levels.learning_objective: Explain that a greenhouse needs equipment and power to operate.
levels.mission_objective: Build and start a greenhouse using available base resources.
levels.debrief: Review the greenhouse needs and its first contribution.

levels.name: Breathing Matters
levels.learning_objective: Compare oxygen production, use, and emergency reserves.
levels.mission_objective: Keep oxygen reserves within a safe game-defined range.
levels.debrief: Trace how oxygen entered and left storage.

levels.name: Radiation Alert
levels.learning_objective: Understand why radiation monitoring matters on Mars.
levels.mission_objective: Read the radiation monitor and record an exposure plan.
levels.debrief: Separate measured NASA facts from game exposure rules.

levels.name: Shelter Protocol
levels.learning_objective: Explain how shelter and shielding can reduce exposure in a game scenario.
levels.mission_objective: Prepare the crew and shelter for a solar particle event.
levels.debrief: Review the shelter choices and their game effects.

levels.name: Finding Water
levels.learning_objective: Use evidence and site information to plan an ice survey.
levels.mission_objective: Choose a survey target and gather evidence before mining.
levels.debrief: Review what the evidence supports and what remains unknown.

levels.name: Ice Operations
levels.learning_objective: Explain that extraction capacity limits water collection.
levels.mission_objective: Operate an ice system and maintain a useful water reserve.
levels.debrief: Review extraction, storage, and energy costs.

levels.name: Food and Supplies
levels.learning_objective: Plan food use, storage, and greenhouse contributions.
levels.mission_objective: Keep food supplies organized while supporting base needs.
levels.debrief: Compare stored food with planned use.

levels.name: Crew Care
levels.learning_objective: Balance crew health, morale, temperature, workload, and rest.
levels.mission_objective: Assign crew tasks while protecting time for rest and wellbeing.
levels.debrief: Review workload and crew support choices.

levels.name: Mission Control
levels.learning_objective: Coordinate forecasts, maintenance, research, and logistics.
levels.mission_objective: Plan several base systems together using current forecasts.
levels.debrief: Review how plans across systems affected the base.

levels.name: The Final Mission
levels.learning_objective: Apply learned settlement skills to a connected mission challenge.
levels.mission_objective: Guide the persistent base through a final combined challenge.
levels.debrief: Celebrate progress and review the choices that sustained the base.

badges.name: Night Owl
badges.description: Complete Power Storage and learn why night needs stored energy.

badges.name: Dust Fighter
badges.description: Complete The Great Storm and plan for dusty skies.

badges.name: Air Keeper
badges.description: Complete Breathing Matters and balance life support.

badges.name: Shield Up
badges.description: Complete Shelter Protocol and practise protecting the crew.

badges.name: Ice Hunter
badges.description: Complete Ice Operations and turn a water plan into action.

badges.name: Commander
badges.description: Complete the full BASE 67 campaign with your persistent base.

badges.name: Learned the Hard Way
badges.description: Review an unsuccessful mission debrief and choose Retry.
